The Associates Program Operating Agreement was re-read through Section 7 and its Section 5 disclosure sentence compared with the sentence the site prints on every page. The FTC 'Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers' page was re-read. Attempts to re-read the Item-details/specification tables returned advertising modules (P1), a bot checkpoint (P2) or the same advertising modules (P3 via the mobile route, which served the desktop layout), so those rows are NOT re-confirmed on this pass and F-38 stands.
_meta.environment_note: One page load of the P2 product page returned an Amazon 'checkpoint/continue' bot-verification page instead of the product page. A later load of the P1 page succeeded. Page-level variability and bot checks are recorded here so a later reviewer knows why some fields were not re-read, not as a doubt about the stored values.
